name: Keep the invisible variant of each color

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown: Style::paint pairs every filled quad and every border quad with the fill color at alpha 0 (`opacity(0.)`), and Color::opacity rebuilds a whole Color from XYZ (encoded conversion, a new Arc of a large ColorInner) each time. A profile of hover-grid showed 103 main-thread samples under Background::opacity and 53 memmove samples moving the new ColorInner. Keeping the alpha-0 twin in the color makes every later request a handle clone.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Add a OnceLock<Color> to ColorInner, return it from Color::opacity for a factor of zero or less, test that it equals with_alpha(0), is one value with one prepared paint color, and that other factors are unchanged. Alternate the previous and new binaries three times on hover-grid, dashboard-all-panels and scroll-div-cards with fast mode on.

measurements.metric: hover-grid CPU / draw p50 / allocations per frame

reportMarkdown: Fewer allocations everywhere a filled or bordered element is painted; footprint unchanged. gpux-color tests (4 paint color tests including the new one) and the gpux lib color tests pass, clippy and fmt are clean.
decisionMarkdown: Keep: a small cache in a leaf crate, -6% on the hover-grid, no cost elsewhere.
